name: La Casa de Norma
tagline: We are rebuilding a house. We are building a legacy.
shortDescription: A campaign to rebuild Norma's family home in Riacho He Hé, Formosa, after the fire of 7 September.
longDescription: La Casa de Norma is a campaign to rebuild the family home of Norma, one of the first social communicators of Riacho He Hé, in the province of Formosa, Argentina. On 7 September a fire destroyed the house, and Norma died that night.
status: Campaign open to raise the funds for the reconstruction.
